_about: Cue kind -> earshot bank sound for The cable and the stub (indieagent-cable-and-stub, draft 1c). Its assets/cues.json comes from cues.mjs: each shot reports its own moves through cue()/segc()/cueWhen() in js/kit.js. For a move (segc), size is the move's length in ms, so bands pick a longer take for a longer move; for bulb it is the bulb's index; for loop and plug it is which one (1, 2, 3). The score under it (drafting-table take-01, bars 23-35) is C major at 96 BPM, so every pitched sound sits in C. Paper and air for the stub, rubber and brass for the cable, glass for the lights. Levels are set on the phone band (300-3400 Hz), each sound alone at its loudest 100 ms against the score there: hits about 10 dB under the score, moves about 13 dB under, the slow drags and the skid about 16 dB under. The score drops out under the last bar and a half, so the plug-in, the lamp, the lights and the amp hum carry the ending on their own.

breath._why: the cable asleep on the amp, one slow breath under the opening

door._why: the stage door sliding open a crack

gust._why: the wind that carries the stub: in under the door, out again, up the fence

flutter._why: the stub in flight: paper turning over in the air

land._why: the stub settling in the ghost light's pool: a soft finger tap (the paper-ish takes had almost nothing on the phone band)

bounce._why: the stub touching down as it tumbles down the alley

reform._why: the cable changing shape (coil, hook, wheel, spring, pole, the swing up into the amp): a rubber swish as long as the move

loop._why: the symbol each time it closes: a glockenspiel note rising through the C triad (the score has glockenspiel accents)

knock._why: the hook catching the door frame

whip._why: the cable whipping out of the door after the stub

roll._why: the cable rolling down the alley as a wheel

skid._why: the stub skating across the puddle on its edge

squash._why: the spring squashing down at the kerb

boing._why: the spring's vault over the lot, a rising arc

stretch._why: the cable growing tall as a pole

lasso._why: the lasso flying up to the stub

sparkle._why: the sparkles when the stub is caught

swing._why: the swing down from the fire escape

bulb._why: each marquee bulb on the string lighting, left to right: a celesta climbing the C scale (size = the bulb's index)

drag._why: the cable towing the stub under the door and across the stage

plug._why: the cable's job: a jack seating in the guitar, then in the amp

lamp._why: the amp's pilot lamp switching on

hum._why: the amp coming alive under the pilot lamp, held through the last bar where the score has stopped

lights._why: the stage lights coming up: a soft airy thump

blink._why: the stub's blink in the last shot
